defects.title: Quote leaks to recipients who never had the quoted message
defects.quote: LEAK CHECK ... on the text you write (the gmail_quote and MCP's plain-text quote are mail their recipients already had, decision 452, and aren't checked)
defects.scenario: PR writes to Zoya only ('founder is touchy about the layoffs', or quoting our earlier PR-only sponsored price). STEP 0r recording link / 453 themes / guest-facing rule puts the guest in To ('To the guest ... PR goes in Cc'; 'To whoever asked and the guest's side'). Guest receives the PR's message and its nested chain unchecked. Same for invite-sourced stakeholders.
defects.fix: Exempt the quote only when every To/Cc address (less team) was on the quoted message's From/To/Cc; otherwise run LEAK CHECK on the whole quote, nested quotes included, and on a hit put the mail on Akshay's list.

defects.title: Approved-link and SHOW CHECK hard rules not exempted for the quote
defects.quote: Never a link outside the approved list (a zencastr.app.link room link only as SENDING allows, decision 445).
defects.scenario: Almost every quoted inbound carries signature or Calendly links; on un#/BTS/HBD nested Akshay or FT mail carries 'Founder Thesis'. Read beside the explicit LEAK CHECK exemption, a literal Sonnet blocks the send or files 'show check failed' on Akshay's list.
defects.fix: Add '(the gmail_quote and MCP's plain-text quote aside)' to the link HARD RULE and SHOW CHECK.

defects.title: Loop-in from ad@ can quote a team-only message
defects.quote: that person never wrote on it (a new contact after a handover): draft action reply on the thread's latest message
defects.scenario: In ad@, the thread's latest message is Akshay to Mamatha only ('decline, low fit'); the new-contact loop-in replies on it and its gmail_quote (#11) quotes it to the new contact.
defects.fix: Same filter as THREADING: the latest message someone outside the team sent or received.

defects.title: Same-day recording link may never send
defects.quote: Else send it in the first run after the link arrives (quiet hours aside), never later than the day before the recording
defects.scenario: Link arrives on recording day (the Sameet case). 'never later than the day before' reads as a bar; the 24h Akshay ask fires only with 'no room link anywhere', so nobody acts.
defects.fix: 'send it in the first run after the link arrives (quiet hours aside), whatever the time left; the day before is the latest it should wait'.

defects.title: D2 read-back is self-certifying
defects.quote: if draft_read shows no html, that the html_body you passed ends with it
defects.scenario:
draft update (To/Cc, and now 447 subject) drops html_body; read-back passes; mail goes without the quote (status quo) or without the

html. Not a leak, but 452 is unverified.
defects.fix: Settle before deploy with a read-only check: email_read a recent r11 Sent mail that went via draft update and see whether its HTML survived; else the one-draft test with Akshay's ok.

defects.title: 453 vs 448 order
defects.quote: Don't answer it, even a "will revert" or a mail with no ask
defects.scenario: Guest asks for themes in reply to Akshay's own mail: 448 comes first, so themes go to Akshay, against 453.
defects.fix: State which wins (likely: a themes ask on a Prep-note row is 453's even on Akshay's thread).

defects.title: 453 has no fallback when the prep note lacks 'Themes we'll cover'
defects.fix: No such section or page unreadable: Akshay's list, no send.

defects.title: Quote HTML size and sanitising
defects.scenario: Long chains give 50KB+ HTML that Sonnet must copy into html_body; truncation breaks tags. Only html/head/body/style/script/cid img stripped; iframe/form/meta/link/on* handlers pass.
defects.fix: Over ~20KB inner HTML: use the escaped text of the message's own part; also strip iframe, form, meta, link and on* attributes.

defects.title: 450 residue in FAST
defects.quote: - SLOW work only: Rules for Zoya: follow-ups 40b19a301a7f81999c1acd8350d59a54
defects.scenario: FAST still loads the SLOW-only page every hourly run (cost), and 'TEAM WHATSAPP names' points to a section FAST no longer has.
defects.fix: Drop the follow-ups page from FAST's RULES LOAD; reword the WhatsApp line.

defects.title: A without B stops SLOW work
defects.fix: Deploy A and enable Zoya SLOW in one window, as 450 says.
